info.title: API.SH: ClickBus
info.description: The ClickBus API from API.SH: public ClickBus data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Itinerary of one trip from `/clickbus/v1/trips`: each leg with departure and arrival terminal, address, date and time, duration, waiting time, seat class, company, bus features and intermediate stops when the company publishes them. Trip ids stop working after departure. Without `trip_id`, give `origin` and `destination` (and `days_ahead`) for the first trip on that route and day.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clickbus-itinerary

parameters.name: trip_id
parameters.description: Trip id from `/clickbus/v1/trips` (`trip_ids`); up to four, comma-separated, for a connection.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin place slug, when no `trip_id` is given.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination place slug, when no `trip_id` is given.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Day of that trip, days from today (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The date nearest to a given day on which ClickBus has a low fare between two places (the place ids `/clickbus/v1/trips` returns as `place_id`). Search after, before or both ways.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clickbus-low-fare-date

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Reference date this many days from today (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Bus places (cities and terminals) matching a name, as the ClickBus search box suggests them: id, name, slug (the value `/clickbus/v1/trips` takes), whether the slug covers every terminal in the city, city name and id. Or the places near a point with `lat`, `lon` and `radius_km`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clickbus-places

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: City or terminal name, 2+ characters, e.g. `campinas`, `rio de janeiro`. Give `q` or `lat` and `lon`.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude for places near a point.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude for places near a point.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The ClickBus page of a route: lowest and highest fare and number of offers, the terminals at both ends (address, phone), every company on the route with its passenger rating (average, number of reviews and scores for driver courtesy, safety, cleanliness, punctuality, bus condition, seat comfort and baggage care) and the seat classes sold.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clickbus-route

get.description:
Every bus terminal ClickBus lists (about 1,900): name, slug, state. Filter by state (UF) or name. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clickbus-stations

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state (UF), e.g. `SP`, or `INT` for international.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every bus trip ClickBus sells between two places on a date: price and original price (BRL), installments, departure and arrival (date, time, terminal, city, state), duration, bus company, seat class, seats left, low-fare flag and low-fare seats, connections, bus features (air conditioning, bathroom, seat recline, leg rest), electronic boarding pass, and the trip ids for `/clickbus/v1/itinerary`; plus the terminals and companies on the route. Filter by company, departure time window, seat class, direct trips, low fares, max price or gratuity (seniors, ID Jovem, Passe Livre) tickets; sort by departure, price, duration or arrival. With `return_date` the return trips come in `return`. The site lists all trips of a day in one answer (no paging).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clickbus-trips

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin place slug from `/clickbus/v1/places`, e.g. `sao-paulo-tiete-sp` or a whole city `sao-paulo-sp-todos`.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Departure this many days from today (0-330), instead of `date`.

parameters.name: service_class
parameters.description: Seat classes, comma-separated names or ids, e.g. `leito,semi-leito` or `4`.

parameters.name: gratuity
parameters.description: `true`: trips with gratuity seats (seniors, ID Jovem, Passe Livre).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
